text: Bitcoin is holding steady near recent highs with modest gains, while Ethereum is slightly underwater and lagging performance despite greed conditions. The market is in a cautious accumulation phase—BTC dominance at 58.8% signals confidence in the largest asset, but the broad flatness across major altcoins and contracting sentiment (-12 on Fear & Greed over a week) suggests traders are consolidating rather than committing to fresh positions. Volume at $50B is moderate, indicating neither panic nor explosive conviction.
